g.aria-label: caught by neither ASM.a nor ASM.b

the diagonal gap is as real as the orthogonal one for handling,
a degenerate-polygon sanity check, not a minimum die size;
a boundary of exactly ASM_e is not flagged
read the selectors in order: overlapping keeps pads
